description: NaTi₃FeO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and two longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three TiO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.16 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-25°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.10 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.22 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-30°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.29 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ti and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Ti and one Fe atom to form distorted OTi₃Fe trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent OTi₃Fe trigonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent OTi₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Ti and two equivalent Fe atoms to form distorted OTi₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent OTi₂Fe₂ trigonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent OTi₃Fe trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ti and one Fe atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms.
